rules.description: SYN attempt to the SMTP service.
HELO/EHLO marker bytes are present on the SMTP transport.
MAIL FROM marker bytes are present.
RCPT TO marker bytes are present.
DATA marker bytes are present; verify the SMTP state and response.
The SMTP terminator byte pattern occurs in a captured frame; reassembly and a dot-stuffing test establish correct message framing.

manual_checks: R1 R2 R3 R4: Assert the corresponding SMTP status codes and intended recipient.
R5 R6: Reassemble the TCP stream, test dot-stuffing and verify maildir storage; a dot substring alone does not prove valid termination.
